tools.name: valet_list_services
tools.description: List the 9 canonical valet service slugs with display name and category. Use this when an agent needs to validate or discover the supported service taxonomy before composing a follow-up search (e.g. valet_search_by_service_and_city). Returns the in-bundle catalog; no upstream call; no isError path.

tools.name: valet_get_operator
tools.description: Get the full operator profile by slug including address, phone, listing URL, website (paid listings only), services, venues_served, FAQs, and tipping note. Use this when an agent has a slug from a search tool or directory URL and needs the profile. Returns isError on slug 404 or upstream outage.

slug.description: Canonical kebab-case operator slug (e.g. '12-oaks-parking-llc'). Lowercase letters, digits, hyphens only.

tools.name: valet_search_cities
tools.description: Search the cities directory by name prefix with population-ranked results. Use this when an agent needs to resolve a partial city name into a canonical city slug plus state slug plus lat/lng before composing valet_find_operators_in_city or valet_find_operators_near. Empty array if no matches.

query.description: Partial or full city name (>=2 chars). Matched against name and lowercase name fields with prefix semantics.

limit.description: Max results to return; default 8, capped at 25

tools.name: valet_find_operators_in_city
tools.description: List valet operators serving a city slug plus state slug, optionally narrowed by service. Use this when an agent has a city already disambiguated and wants its operator roster ranked by listing tier then name. Empty array if no listed operators.

service.description: Optional service narrowing. One of the 9 canonical valet service slugs. Omit to list every operator serving the city.

limit.description: Max results to return; default 10, capped at 50

tools.name: valet_search_by_service_and_city
tools.description: Search valet operators by service slug plus city slug across all matching states. Use this when an agent has both a service slug and a city slug and wants a cross-state tier-then-name ranked list. Invalid service slugs surface the 9 canonical alternatives.

service_slug.description: Required canonical valet service slug. One of 9 values; call valet_list_services for the full set.

city_slug.description: Lowercase kebab-case city slug (e.g. 'austin', 'springfield'). May match multiple cities across states.

limit.description: Max results to return; default 10, capped at 50

tools.name: valet_find_nearest_operators
tools.description: List nearest valet operators within a 100-mile cap of a coordinate, optionally narrowed by service. Use this when a user is in a city with no listed operators and you need the closest available fallback ranked nearest-first. Empty array if nothing within 100 miles.

lat.description: Latitude in decimal degrees (WGS84). Range: -90 to 90.

lng.description: Longitude in decimal degrees (WGS84). Range: -180 to 180.

service.description: Optional service narrowing. One of the 9 canonical valet service slugs. Omit to list every nearby operator regardless of services offered.

limit.description: Max results to return; default 10, capped at 50

tools.name: valet_find_operators_near
tools.description: Find valet operators within a given radius of a coordinate, ranked by listing tier then distance. Use this when you have a coordinate and an event-context radius (5mi single venue, 25mi metro, 50mi regional). radius_miles is required; empty array if no matches.

lat.description: Latitude in decimal degrees (WGS84). Range: -90 to 90.

lng.description: Longitude in decimal degrees (WGS84). Range: -180 to 180.

radius_miles.description: Search radius in miles. REQUIRED, no default. Pick based on context: 5 mi for a single venue, 25 mi for a metro, 50 mi for a regional sweep.

service.description: Optional service narrowing. One of the 9 canonical valet service slugs. Omit to list every operator within radius regardless of services offered.

limit.description: Max results to return; default 10, capped at 50

tools.name: valet_request_quote
tools.description: Submit a valet parking quote request to the operators serving a US city. Use this when a person has asked you to arrange valet and has given their name, email, phone, city, service type and event date. The request is only sent after they confirm by email.

contact_email.description: Email address to send the one-tap confirmation link to

contact_phone.description: Phone number the operator can call

city_slug.description: Canonical kebab-case city slug from valet_search_cities, e.g. 'austin'. Omit if using city_other.

city_other.description: Free-text city name when no directory slug is known. Omit if using city_slug.

service.description: One of the 9 canonical valet service slugs

notes.description: Free-text notes for the operator, e.g. venue name or timing details

operator_slug.description: Send to this one operator only instead of the full fan-out for the city. Omit to notify every matched operator in the city.
